significance: A Vishnu temple in the Singanallur quarter of Coimbatore whose north-facing presiding image is cast in panchaloha. It was renovated in 2000 and its seven-tiered tower consecrated at a Kumbhabhishekam in 2005.
story: The temple's own account holds that the Chola king Karikalan founded it while passing through Singanallur on a campaign, for the welfare of the people.
